item.prompt: Reason for referral in the person's own words

guidance: A sufficient answer records what prompted the referral and roughly when the difficulty began. 'I'm not sure' or a restatement of the referral source alone is not sufficient.
turns: It's the breathlessness. I can't manage the walk to the shop any more.
label: sufficient
why: Onset in turn one, difficulty in turn two — combined they satisfy.
